## Personality

Thomas Lynde is described as a meek little man. Among the people of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), he is known simply as "[Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) Lynde's husband."

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)_

## History

Thomas Lynde was the husband of Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who was known in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for her intense curiosity and strong opinions. He lived with his wife, who actively monitored the goings-on in their community.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025)_

## Relationships

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

Thomas Lynde is married to Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). While he is not directly present during her visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), his wife actively manages their household and keeps close tabs on the affairs of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community.
